paraphrase.label: Paraphrase
paraphrase.hint: Say what the visual shows, where and when, in your own words. No opinions.

overview-main.label: Overview: main feature
overview-main.hint: The biggest trend or the biggest difference. No numbers yet.

overview-second.label: Overview: second feature
overview-second.hint: A contrast, a second trend or a stand-out figure.

topic.label: Topic sentence
topic.hint: One clear main idea (or group of data) for this paragraph.

key-figures.label: Key figures
key-figures.hint: Give exact data for the main item, with units.

comparison.label: Comparison
comparison.hint: Compare with another item: whereas, while, higher than.

trend-detail.label: Trend detail
trend-detail.hint: Describe movement over time: rose steadily to, peaked at.

link.label: Link
link.hint: Tie back to the question or bridge to the next paragraph.

closing-detail.label: Closing detail
closing-detail.hint: One more notable point. No conclusion needed in Task 1.

background.label: Background
background.hint: Paraphrase the topic neutrally. Do not copy the question.

thesis.label: Thesis
thesis.hint: Answer the question directly. Reuse the question's key terms.

explanation.label: Explanation
explanation.hint: Why or how the idea holds.

example.label: Example
example.hint: Specific and believable: a country, a study, a common situation.

effect.label: Result or effect
effect.hint: What the example proves or what follows from it.

summary.label: Summary
summary.hint: Restate your position and main reasons in new words.

judgement.label: Final judgement
judgement.hint: A short closing thought. No new ideas.
